#notes: account achievements (specs/18 section 8): checked when a run is sealed. rank_reached: a run reaches rank ref. Placeholder condition and reward
stat_reached: a sealed monster has stat ref (empty = any stat) at least amount. Placeholder
runs_finished: amount runs sealed (abandoned runs do not count). Placeholder; no reward yet
gauntlet_floors: a sealed monster clears at least amount gauntlet floors. Placeholder; no reward yet
